regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, dates, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: Verified the true article title and the generic current Pd(dba)2/(R)-DTBM-Biphep/DMPU/-30 °C transformation. The graphical abstract's 19 examples/up-to-99%-yield/up-to-94%-ee values are aggregate method claims and were not assigned to one experiment.

regions.region: page 1 left-column introduction and Scheme 1 cross-references
regions.finding: The prose distinguishes cited prior allenylic substitutions, synergistic Pd/Cu work, and the unreported remote-stereocontrol challenge from the current generic reaction. These are classified as literature/general schemes rather than current experimental rows.

regions.region: page 1 right-column ligand-screening and optimized-condition prose
regions.finding: The narrative maps to the twelve Table 1 ligand rows and identifies L7 (50%, -39% ee), L12 (92%, 91% ee), and later 2.9 mol% optimized scope conditions. No prose-only duplicate runs were created.
The prose summarizes the independently retained oxindole scope rows, including 1a–1q substitutions and the X-ray assignment of (R)-3da; exact row values and footnotes are taken from page 2.

unresolved: The graphical/common schemes contain generic R/LG/PG groups and are not unique structures.
Figure S2 for (R)-3da is in unassociated SI and was not imported.

regions.finding: Equation 1 is cited prior soft-nucleophile allenylation, equation 2 is cited synergistic Pd/Cu chemistry, and equation 3 is the explicitly challenging/not-reported remote-control target. None was treated as a current experiment.

regions.region: page 2 left-center Scheme 1b and bioactive-example panel
regions.finding: Scheme 1b is the generic current reaction class and is merged with the page-1 graphical abstract. The bioactive oxindole structures are contextual examples, not reaction experiments.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Table 1 header, twelve ligand structures, row outcomes, and footnotes
regions.finding: Twelve independent optimization entries were retained with 1a 0.088 mmol, 2a 0.1 mmol, Pd(dba)2/ligand 5.7 mol%, DMPU 0.5 mL, -30 °C, NMR yield/CH2Br2 basis, signed ee, and chiral-HPLC basis. Rows 1–6 use the displayed 13 h; footnote-b rows 7–12 use 12 h.

regions.region: page 2 right-column Table 2 header, entries 1–22, and footnotes a–h
regions.finding: Twenty-two distinct scope/condition rows were retained. Footnotes create NMR-yield small-scale rows 14/18, Segphos rows 15/19, a separate 5 mmol row 17, -28 °C row 19, 10 mL DMPU row 21, and reversed 1s/2a stoichiometry with 5.7 mol% loadings in row 22.
The text introduces four distinct derivatizations of (R)-3oa; their complete arrows and outcomes are on page 3 and were linked cross-page rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Table 2 does not report reaction times, atmosphere, workup, purification eluents, or isolated masses.
Negative Table 1 ee signs are preserved separately from nonnegative magnitude quantities.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Scheme 2 four reaction arrows
regions.finding: Four independent transformations were retained: TFA deprotection to (R)-4 (74%, 92% ee); sequential TFA/NIS cyclization to (R)-5 (73%, 90% ee); Suzuki coupling with boronic acid 6 to (R)-7 (62%, 89% ee); and Cu/Xantphos borylcupration to (R)-8 (73%, 92% ee). Sequential and temperature-transition operations remain ordered.

regions.region: page 3 conclusion and Associated Content/SI statement
regions.finding: The conclusion adds no new experiment. Although the article links online SI and describes its contents, source_mapping.json leaves the association unestablished; no SI procedure, spectrum, HPLC chart, or crystal datum was imported.

CCDC 1958258 and 1970013 are crystallographic depositions for this paper. The main text does not explicitly map each code to a machine structure, so they were not treated as reactions, SI associations, or structure verification.

Yifan Cui is thanked for reproducing Table 2 results (R)-3ha and (R)-3ma. No independent conditions, quantities, yields, or run identifiers are supplied, so provenance notes were attached to entries 8/13 without creating duplicate runs.
Bibliography and prior-work context only; references were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits absolute quantities/loadings, times, workups, isolated masses, yield bases, and ee methods.
SI and CCDC data were not associated with machine structures.
Reproduction acknowledgments do not identify separable runs.
